want: a chart of target against actual spending across the current pay cycle
soThat: I can see part-way through the cycle whether I am tracking to the budget instead of finding out after the money is gone
acceptance: the Budget tab opens on the pay cycle in progress and plots a target series and an actual series for every visible budget line
the actual series is cumulative spend to date and stops at today rather than running to the end of the cycle
a fixed budget line's target steps up on its due day instead of sloping evenly across the cycle
a flexible budget line's target slopes evenly from zero to its full amount across the cycle
